transcript.text: Clearing out a drawer I found a letter from 2020 saying my Hotpoint washing machine might be part of a fire safety recall. Model WMXTF 742P UK. It's been working fine all this time - do I really need to do anything?

Yes, you should act on this immediately. Fire safety recalls are critical because they address defects that can cause fires, even if the appliance currently seems to function normally. The fact that it has worked fine since 2020 does not mean the defect is gone; the underlying risk remains until the manufacturer's modification or repair is completed. Please stop using the washing machine and unplug it from the mains power now. You need to contact Hotpoint directly regarding this recall for your WMXTF 742P UK model. They will arrange for a qualified engineer to visit and fix the issue, often at no cost to you. Do not attempt any repairs yourself.

Oh dear, ok, I'll stop using it. It's in the kitchen and I often run it overnight or when I'm out, so I'm glad I found the letter. Can I still do cold washes in the meantime? And how do I contact Hotpoint about it?

[Heading: Recall repair required]
For your absolute safety, you must not use the washing machine at all—even for cold washes. The defect causing the fire risk is internal and can trigger even when the heating element is off or during a cycle that doesn't heat water. Please contact Hotpoint customer support immediately to arrange the recall repair; they will send an engineer to fix it free of charge. You can find their contact details on the official recall letter you received, or visit the Hotpoint website and search for 'WMXTF 742P UK recall' to get the specific phone number or online form for this safety notice.
